infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coco records overnight audio to detect snoring, sleep talking, and other sounds. Short event clips are saved to your device — nothing is uploaded. The continuous recording is deleted after each session.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Coco uses your location to detect if you've left your bed and auto-end your sleep session.
